subject: Homework: Senior Inference Engineer — prompt release, extension & reviewer schedule
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Homework: Senior Inference Engineer — prompt & instructions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time to interview with us. Attached is the take-home prompt for the Senior Inference Engineer role. Key details:

- What to build: a short write-up + code demonstrating an inference performance/throughput tradeoff for a small transformer model (instructions in the attached PDF).
- Deliverables: single PDF (design + results) and code bundle (zip) in a Drive folder.
- Deadline: 72 hours from now — please submit by Thu, 23 Jul 2026 17:00 PT.
- How to submit: reply to this thread attaching the PDF and include a Drive link to the code.
- Time expectation: ~6–8 hours of focused effort; we only expect a concise, replicable demo.

Reviewers: Laura will be primary, Mina secondary, Monica observability reviewer. They will coordinate scoring after submission.

Attachments: sr-inference-takehome.pdf (PDF, 4 pages) — contains prompt, data, and scoring guidance.

If anything in the prompt looks ambiguous, please flag here. Good luck!

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform
